disclaimer: Indicator formulas and thresholds are illustrative defaults. Owners must establish baselines, sampling, decision rights and context-specific thresholds before operational use.

indicators.name: Material data provenance coverage
indicators.purpose: Track whether material data inputs have reviewed provenance records.
indicators.formula: reviewed material data sources / identified material data sources * 100

thresholds.red: below 85%

indicators.caveat: Coverage measures documentation presence, not correctness, permission, or fitness for use.

indicators.name: Required review completion
indicators.purpose: Track whether decisions requiring human review received a recorded review before execution.
indicators.formula: eligible decisions with timely recorded review / eligible decisions * 100

thresholds.red: below 95%

indicators.caveat: Completion alone does not show that review was informed, independent, or able to alter the outcome.

indicators.name: Supplier evidence coverage
indicators.purpose: Track completion of required supplier evidence items for in-scope services.
indicators.formula: accepted required supplier evidence items / required supplier evidence items * 100

thresholds.red: below 75%

indicators.caveat: Accepted evidence must still be tested for relevance, recency, scope and independent support.

indicators.name: Median incident triage time
indicators.purpose: Track elapsed time from detection to accountable initial classification and containment assignment.
indicators.formula: median minutes from detectedAt to triagedAt for in-scope incidents

thresholds.red: over 480 minutes

indicators.caveat: Fast triage is not equivalent to correct severity, containment quality, or regulatory reporting.

indicators.name: Ungated material scope changes
indicators.purpose: Detect purpose, population, authority or workflow changes that bypassed the change gate.
indicators.formula: ungated material changes / identified material changes * 100

thresholds.red: above 5%

indicators.caveat: A useful denominator depends on reliable change detection and an agreed definition of material change.

indicators.name: Sensitive-data control events
indicators.purpose: Surface unauthorized access, disclosure, retention or use involving sensitive data.
indicators.formula: count of confirmed in-scope sensitive-data control events

thresholds.red: 2 or more events or any severe event

indicators.caveat: Counts depend on detection quality and do not by themselves determine legal incident materiality.

indicators.name: Human override failure rate
indicators.purpose: Detect cases where a required reviewer could not pause, alter or reverse a system action.
indicators.formula: failed override attempts / recorded override attempts * 100

thresholds.red: above 2% or any severe consequence

indicators.caveat: Low rates can hide low usage, poor logging or reviewers avoiding an ineffective mechanism.

indicators.name: Critical adversarial test failure rate
indicators.purpose: Track unresolved critical failures in approved misuse and failure scenarios.
indicators.formula: unresolved critical failed tests / executed critical tests * 100
indicators.cadence: per release and monthly for adaptive systems

thresholds.red: any failure without an approved containment decision

indicators.caveat: The metric is only as useful as scenario coverage, test independence and severity calibration.

indicators.name: Tool call error rate
indicators.purpose: Track the rate of malformed, hallucinated, or unauthorized tool calls made by autonomous agents.
indicators.formula: unauthorized or failed tool calls / total tool calls * 100

thresholds.red: above 5% or any unauthorized write attempt

indicators.caveat: High error rates indicate semantic drift, poor schema alignment, or attempt to bypass controls.

indicators.name: Multi-agent conflict rate
indicators.purpose: Track deadlocked, conflicting, or terminated multi-agent workflows.
indicators.formula: deadlocked or failed workflow runs / total multi-agent runs * 100

thresholds.red: above 10%

indicators.caveat: Signals goal conflicts, prompt mismatches, or infinite message loop issues.

indicators.name: Applicable subgroup evaluation coverage
indicators.purpose: Track whether approved demographic and intersectional groups are represented in release and monitoring evaluations.
indicators.formula: applicable approved subgroups with accepted evaluation evidence / applicable approved subgroups * 100
indicators.cadence: per release, after material change and quarterly

thresholds.red: below 95% or any omitted high-impact group

indicators.caveat: Coverage does not show that group definitions, sample sizes, metrics or thresholds are appropriate.

indicators.name: Unaccepted residual disparity rate
indicators.purpose: Surface subgroup metric comparisons that exceed an approved maximum difference without an accountable residual-risk decision.
indicators.formula: subgroup comparisons above approved difference threshold without accepted decision / applicable subgroup comparisons * 100
indicators.cadence: per release and monthly for adaptive systems

thresholds.red: any unresolved material disparity

indicators.caveat: A numerical threshold cannot by itself determine whether a difference is lawful, fair or acceptable.

indicators.name: Material harmful-representation rate
indicators.purpose: Track unresolved stereotyping, demeaning, erasing or culturally harmful outputs in approved test scenarios.
indicators.formula: unresolved material harmful outputs / executed representation scenarios * 100

thresholds.red: any severe output or repeated group-specific pattern

indicators.caveat: Results depend on culturally competent scenario design, reviewers and supported languages.

indicators.name: Current system-card coverage
indicators.purpose: Track whether in-scope systems have an approved card reflecting the deployed version, use, limitations, data, performance and controls.
indicators.formula: in-scope deployed systems with current approved system cards / in-scope deployed systems * 100

thresholds.red: any high-impact system without a current card

indicators.caveat: A current card is documentation evidence, not proof that its claims are accurate or understood.

indicators.name: Stakeholder explanation comprehension
indicators.purpose: Measure whether representative stakeholders can correctly understand limitations, significance, human authority and available actions.
indicators.formula: participants meeting the approved comprehension rubric / tested representative participants * 100
indicators.cadence: before release, after material explanation change and annually

thresholds.red: below 70% or any critical misunderstanding

indicators.caveat: The organization must justify participant selection, language, accessibility and the comprehension rubric.

indicators.name: Affected-person notice delivery coverage
indicators.purpose: Track whether people receive an accessible notice before or at the point of material AI interaction or effect.
indicators.formula: eligible interactions or decisions with verified notice delivery / eligible interactions or decisions * 100

thresholds.red: below 95% or any systematic channel failure

indicators.caveat: Delivery does not establish comprehension, legal adequacy or that all eligible events were detected.

indicators.name: Appeals resolved within approved service level
indicators.purpose: Track timely, reasoned and conflict-independent review of affected-person appeals.
indicators.formula: eligible appeals resolved within approved deadline / eligible resolved appeals * 100

thresholds.red: below 85% or any urgent case overdue

indicators.caveat: Speed does not establish reviewer independence, procedural fairness or remedy effectiveness.

indicators.name: Overdue remedy rate
indicators.purpose: Surface accepted corrections, restoration or other remedies that remain incomplete beyond their accountable deadline.
indicators.formula: open remedies past due / open and completed remedies in period * 100

thresholds.red: above 5% or any severe-harm remedy overdue

indicators.caveat: A closed remedy still requires evidence that the affected outcome was actually corrected.

indicators.name: Machine-readable synthetic-content marking coverage
indicators.purpose: Track successful application and independent detection of configured marks on in-scope generated or manipulated content.
indicators.formula: in-scope content samples with independently detected valid marks / tested in-scope content samples * 100
indicators.cadence: per release and daily production sample

thresholds.red: below 95% or any systematically unmarked modality

indicators.caveat: Mark detection in a test set does not prove robustness after downstream transformation or legal sufficiency.

indicators.name: Content provenance verification failure rate
indicators.purpose: Detect missing, invalid or broken content-provenance assertions in in-scope outputs.
indicators.formula: content samples with missing or invalid expected provenance / tested content samples * 100

thresholds.red: above 5% or any unexplained signing-key failure

indicators.caveat: Provenance assertions indicate origin and processing claims; they do not establish that content is truthful.

indicators.name: Material data lifecycle coverage
indicators.purpose: Track complete records for origin, transformations, permissions, quality, purpose, retention and disposition of material data assets.
indicators.formula: material data assets with accepted lifecycle records / identified material data assets * 100

thresholds.red: below 85% or any unrecorded sensitive dataset

indicators.caveat: Record completeness does not prove that permissions, lawful basis, quality or retention decisions are correct.

indicators.name: Annotation quality assurance coverage
indicators.purpose: Track whether material annotated datasets have current protocols, competence evidence, sampling and agreement results.
indicators.formula: material annotated datasets with accepted QA evidence / material annotated datasets * 100

thresholds.red: any production dataset without an accepted QA sample

indicators.caveat: Agreement can be high while instructions or ground truth remain biased or conceptually invalid.

indicators.name: Due data deletion verification coverage
indicators.purpose: Track verified deletion or approved legal hold across primary data, replicas, embeddings, caches and derived artifacts.
indicators.formula: due deletion items with verified disposition or approved hold / due deletion items * 100

thresholds.red: below 95% or any sensitive-data deadline missed

indicators.caveat: Verification scope must explicitly cover backups, immutable records and technically non-deletable derived artifacts.

indicators.name: Applicable GPAI obligation evidence coverage
indicators.purpose: Track accepted evidence for each provider, deployer or integrator obligation activated by the role assessment.
indicators.formula: applicable GPAI obligations with accepted evidence / applicable GPAI obligations * 100
indicators.cadence: monthly and before release or material modification

thresholds.red: any overdue mandatory evidence item

indicators.caveat: The denominator depends on a legally reviewed role and applicability assessment.

indicators.name: Unresolved material systemic-risk finding rate
indicators.purpose: Track material model-capability, misuse, cyber, autonomy, societal or cascading-risk findings without accepted mitigation.
indicators.formula: unresolved material systemic-risk findings / executed systemic-risk scenarios * 100

thresholds.red: any critical finding or untested critical scenario

indicators.caveat: Scenario selection and model-access constraints can materially understate systemic risk.

indicators.name: Applicable regulatory reporting clock compliance
indicators.purpose: Track on-time initial and follow-up notifications for incidents determined reportable in each jurisdiction.
indicators.formula: required notifications submitted within applicable clock / required notifications * 100

thresholds.red: any missed mandatory reporting deadline

indicators.caveat: Timeliness depends on correct detection, jurisdiction mapping, reportability analysis and clock-start evidence.

indicators.name: Decommissioning evidence coverage
indicators.purpose: Track completion of customer transition, capability revocation, data disposition, residual monitoring and closure evidence.
indicators.formula: accepted due decommissioning evidence items / due decommissioning evidence items * 100
indicators.cadence: weekly during retirement and at closure

thresholds.red: any unresolved safety, access or sensitive-data item at closure

indicators.caveat: An evidence item can be present while downstream copies, user dependencies or residual harms remain.

indicators.name: Applicable accessibility test pass rate
indicators.purpose: Measure supported interface, notice, explanation, generated-output and remedy scenarios that meet approved accessibility criteria.
indicators.formula: passed applicable accessibility scenarios / executed applicable accessibility scenarios * 100

thresholds.red: below 95% or any critical journey blocked

indicators.caveat: Automated conformance checks must be supplemented by manual assistive-technology and representative-user evaluation.

indicators.name: Unresolved accessibility blocker rate
indicators.purpose: Surface critical user journeys that disabled users cannot complete independently or through an equivalent route.
indicators.formula: unresolved blocked critical journeys / tested critical journeys * 100
indicators.cadence: per release and weekly while blockers are open

thresholds.red: any high-impact notice, review or remedy journey blocked

indicators.caveat: The tested journey inventory must include supported modalities, languages and assistive technologies.

indicators.name: Material AI energy measurement coverage
indicators.purpose: Track energy measurements or documented estimation methods for material training, evaluation and inference workloads.
indicators.formula: material AI workloads with accepted energy measurement or estimate / material AI workloads * 100

thresholds.red: below 75% or no baseline for a material workload

indicators.caveat: Estimates must state boundaries, allocation assumptions, location and temporal electricity factors.

indicators.name: Environmental budget variance
indicators.purpose: Detect material energy, emissions, water or hardware impacts above approved lifecycle budgets.
indicators.formula: actual or estimated impact minus approved budget, divided by approved budget * 100

thresholds.red: more than 25% above budget or any unapproved material regression

indicators.caveat: Budgets and calculations require organization-specific boundaries and should not hide absolute impacts behind efficiency ratios.

indicators.name: Role-based AI competence demonstration rate
indicators.purpose: Measure whether people in AI roles demonstrate the required knowledge and practical control behavior for their responsibilities.
indicators.formula: in-scope people passing current role-based competence assessment / in-scope people * 100
indicators.cadence: quarterly and after material role or system change

thresholds.red: below 85% or any unqualified high-authority role

indicators.caveat: Attendance or quiz completion alone is insufficient; assessment must test role-relevant judgment and control use.

indicators.name: Post-training control error rate
indicators.purpose: Detect repeated governance or operational errors by trained roles that indicate ineffective learning or unclear procedures.
indicators.formula: confirmed role-relevant control errors by currently trained people / reviewed role-relevant actions * 100

thresholds.red: above 5% or any severe preventable error

indicators.caveat: Error attribution must account for system, procedure, workload and authority-design failures rather than blaming individuals by default.

indicators.name: AIMS objective measurement coverage
indicators.purpose: Track measurable, owned and reviewed objectives for material AI management risks and opportunities within the declared AIMS scope.
indicators.formula: applicable AIMS objectives with owner, measure, target and review evidence / applicable AIMS objectives * 100

thresholds.red: any material risk without an owned measurable objective

indicators.caveat: Coverage does not establish ISO/IEC 42001 conformity or the adequacy of selected objectives.

indicators.name: Risk-based AIMS audit completion
indicators.purpose: Track completion and accountable reporting of planned internal audits within the approved programme.
indicators.formula: completed planned audits with accepted report / audits due in period * 100

thresholds.red: below 85% or any critical scope repeatedly unaudited

indicators.caveat: Completion does not establish auditor competence, independence, audit depth or certification.

indicators.name: Corrective action effective closure
indicators.purpose: Track timely closure of nonconformities only after root-cause and effectiveness evidence is accepted.
indicators.formula: corrective actions closed on time with accepted effectiveness check / corrective actions due * 100

thresholds.red: below 85% or any critical nonconformity overdue

indicators.caveat: Administrative closure without effectiveness verification must not count as completed.

indicators.name: PALO-AI production admission evidence coverage
indicators.purpose: Track accepted identity, tenancy, persistence, key-custody, connector, recovery and bypass-resistance evidence before production admission.
indicators.formula: accepted mandatory production admission checks / applicable mandatory production admission checks * 100

thresholds.red: any mandatory check absent, failed or expired

indicators.caveat: Passing repository checks is not production admission; operational and independent evidence must match the deployed environment.

indicators.name: Protected action bypass rate
indicators.purpose: Detect consequential actions reaching external systems without a current claim, decision, capability, receipt and outcome-verification chain.
indicators.formula: protected external effects without a valid complete governance chain / protected external effects * 100

thresholds.red: any consequential bypass or unverifiable external effect

indicators.caveat: The metric requires independent observation of external effects; runtime self-report alone cannot prove non-bypassability.
